Terms and Conditions.

Welcome to Xtreme Jetski Watersports! Before using our services, we require you to carefully read and agree to our terms and conditions:

  1. Safety is our top priority. Xtreme Jetski Watersports reserves the right to cancel any reservation or refuse service to any person who is deemed unsafe or intoxicated.

  2. All participants must be at least 18 years of age or have written consent from a parent or legal guardian.

  3. All participants must be able to swim and wear a life jacket at all times during the activity.

  4. All participants must complete a safety briefing before starting any activity.

  5. Xtreme Jetski Watersports is not liable for any injuries or damages that occur during the activity. Participants assume all risks and are required to sign a liability waiver before participating.

  6. Cancellations and refunds: Participants must provide at least 72 hours' notice for cancellations or rescheduling. No-shows or cancellations made less than 72 hours in advance will not be refunded.

  7. Weather conditions: Xtreme Jetski Watersports reserves the right to cancel or reschedule any activity due to weather conditions or safety concerns.

  8. Participants must follow all instructions and safety guidelines given by Xtreme Jetski Watersports staff.

  9. Participants may not bring any outside equipment or gear unless approved by Xtreme Jetski Watersports staff.

  10. Participants are responsible for any damages caused to the equipment during the activity.

  11. Participants must not engage in any reckless or dangerous behavior during the activity.

  12. Xtreme Jetski Watersports reserves the right to modify or update these terms and conditions at any time without notice.

By using our services, you agree to these terms and conditions. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us before participating.
